description: Declarative catalog of standard Antigravity MCP servers across workstations.

github.description: GitHub integration for repository, PR, and issue management via MCP.
github.setup_hint: Create a GitHub PAT with repo scope and add 'export GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN="..."' to ~/.bashrc

fetch.description: Web fetch and content conversion tool for retrieving web pages via MCP.
fetch.setup_hint: Ensure Node.js and npm/npx are installed (e.g., via nvm or package manager).

sqlite.description: Local SQLite database querying and inspection via MCP.
sqlite.setup_hint: Install uv (pip install uv) and add 'export SQLITE_DEV_DB="$HOME/dev.db"' to ~/.bashrc
